study.abstract: Management questionnaire of the fourth European Company Survey (2019), run jointly by Eurofound and Cedefop as a push-to-web survey of establishments in the EU27 and the United Kingdom. A senior manager reports on the establishment's work organisation, digitalisation (computer use, custom software, robots, data analytics), skills match and skill requirements, training and learning, recruitment, variable pay, employee voice and representation, human resource difficulties and business strategy and performance. The published version shows the wording for subsidiary sites of multi-site companies.
study.universe: Establishments with 10 or more employees in economic sectors engaged in market activities in the 27 EU Member States and the United Kingdom; respondent: the most senior manager in charge of personnel (management questionnaire).
